<h2>Audit Completed Continental sjSDM Results for Retention</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Retains a legacy continental regularization decision and final model only
when the final fit converged and calibrated evidence reproduces its winner.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>evaluate_sjsdm_continental_cv_retention(
  data_completed = NULL,
  data_calibration = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_completed">data_completed</code></td>
<td>
<p>Completed unit-resolution rows with final convergence, legacy winner, and
explicit legacy CV/final fitting budgets.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_calibration">data_calibration</code></td>
<td>
<p>Unit-resolution calibration rows with accepted status and winning candidate.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Audit table with deterministic retention decisions and reasons.
</p>

</main>
